description: Two dancers pass across, cast round the line, and meet in the middle.

walkthrough.line: Pass through across the set, cast round the dancer one place along, and come in.
walkthrough.teach: The active couple passes through across the set by the right shoulder, then turns right and casts round the dancer standing one place along the line they have arrived on, going outside the line. They come back into the middle and stop a long way apart, facing each other along the set. The two who stood still are the sides of the diamond and the two actives are its points.
